* '''PC-E2''' ([[Broken Concentration (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-brokenconcentration-pre.gif]]): “Deploy on table. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “2 • 05” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 6 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
